experiment: JANUS P-N Junction v0.3 adaptive depletion-depth detector
fairness: Every method received the same SAT instance and identical initial assignment per trial; method RNG streams were deterministic and method-specific.
parameter_freeze: Detector coefficients and thresholds were fixed in source before executing the holdout suite.
negative_results: At n=48 adaptive v0.3 median steps regressed versus Tunnel v0.2 (52.5 vs 44).
At n=64 adaptive v0.3 and Tunnel v0.2 each failed one of 16 instances while Junction Base solved 16/16.
Python wall-clock time increased because depth and packet-merit diagnostics are expensive.
Oscillation term was not supported by ablation.
UNSAT-core stress exposed the need for a no-recombination/proof-exhaustion state.
next_gate: v0.4 Selective Field: reduce/remove oscillation, preserve charge, gate avalanche by depth+merit, add no-recombination state.
